name: King
source:
"Fumiaaaaawww.......(It's a nice day today.......)"

A black cat who resides on the cat tower in the common room of Minato Dormitory.

He is a cat of the Yasaka family, and is loved by everyone in the dormitory, especially [url=/c104590]Kanon[/url]. He usually roams around the Yasaka's house and the dormitory, and rarely goes beyond these areas. However, he often appears by [url=/c104596]Yuuki[/url]'s side, whenever something happens to him.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/nekoking/character/king.html]Official website[/url]]

[spoiler]It is revealed later in the story that King was sent from another world to watch over the Yasaka family, particularly Yuuki.[/spoiler]
